caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular image bordered by a thick green and pink frame, with a loop of string at the top indicating it is meant to be hung. Inside the frame is a simplified, stylized figure of a woman with black hair, a crown of red, and a black dress. The woman has a hand raised holding a black cross and her other hand placed on her chest. Her collar is green, and her face is pale with minimal facial features. The background consists of two brownish-pink rounded shapes, possibly hills, set against a pale pink backdrop. The surrounding mat and setting of the drawing is off-white, with the artist's name (Mary G. Chaplin-Thos) written in small script at the lower right of the image.
title: Retablo (Virgin)
